application_flow.name: Check Eligibility
application_flow.desc: Verify minimum academic percentage (60%+), domicile state, college accreditation, and family income ceiling.

application_flow.name: Prepare Documents
application_flow.desc: Collect Income Certificate, Community/Caste Certificate, 10+2 Marksheets, Allotment Order, and Aadhaar-seeded Bank Passbook.

application_flow.name: Verification
application_flow.desc: Documents are verified by Tahsildar / e-Sevai / Revenue Officials and confirmed by College Nodal Desk.

application_flow.name: Application
application_flow.desc: Submit the digital form on the State NSP / e-Grantz / University portal before the published deadline.

application_flow.name: Approval
application_flow.desc: State Welfare Board or Central Ministry reviews the verified dossier and issues sanction grant letters.

application_flow.name: Scholarship Result/Benefit
application_flow.desc: Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) funds credited into student bank account or tuition fee directly deducted.

scholarships.name: Amrita Chancellor Merit Scholarship
scholarships.benefit: 25% to 90% Tuition Fee Waiver for top AEEE rankers
scholarships.eligibility_criteria: AEEE Rank under 500 or 95%+ in 10+2 PCM. Maintain 8.5+ CGPA annually.
required_documents: Merit Scholarship Form from Dean Office
scholarships.application_process: Automatic fee discount applied during admission counselling based on rank.

scholarships.eligibility_criteria: Cutoff 180+ in 10+2 PCM or State/National level sports representation.
scholarships.application_process: Direct evaluation at the Adithya Admission Desk during enrollment.

scholarships.name: Central Sector Scheme of Scholarships (CSSS)

scholarships.eligibility_criteria: Top 80th percentile in respective 12th State/CBSE Board. Family income below ₹4.5 Lakh.
scholarships.application_process: Apply on National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in) -> Institute Verification.

scholarships.name: INSPIRE Scholarship for Higher Education (SHE)

scholarships.eligibility_criteria: Top 1% in Class 12 Board Exam or JEE/NEET top rankers opting for Pure Sciences.
required_documents: College Admission Fee Receipt in B.Sc/BS
scholarships.application_process: Online application on online-inspire.gov.in under Department of Science & Technology.

scholarships.name: TNAU Agri-Fellowship & ICAR National Talent Scholarship
